keyPoints.en: in – inside; on – on top, touching
keyPoints.hi: in – अंदर; on – ऊपर, छूते हुए

keyPoints.en: under – below; behind – at the back; in front of – ahead
keyPoints.hi: under – नीचे; behind – पीछे; in front of – आगे

keyPoints.en: between – in the middle of two things

problem.en: The ball is below the chair. Fill in: "The ball is __ the chair."
problem.hi: गेंद कुर्सी के नीचे है। भरो: "The ball is __ the chair."

problem.en: Rohan sits with Asha on his left and Sam on his right. Fill in: "Rohan sits __ Asha and Sam."
problem.hi: रोहन के बाईं ओर आशा और दाईं ओर सैम है। भरो: "Rohan sits __ Asha and Sam."

steps.en: Rohan is in the middle of two people.
steps.hi: रोहन दो लोगों के बीच में है।

question.en: Fill in: "The fish are __ the bowl."
Fill in: "The clock is __ the wall."
Fill in: "The car is __ the house (at the back)."

intro.en: Prepositions of place tell us where something is: in, on, under, behind, in front of, between, near. "The cat is under the table."
intro.hi: स्थान बताने वाले prepositions बताते हैं कि कोई चीज़ कहाँ है: in, on, under, behind, in front of, between, near। "The cat is under the table."
